ce_bugs.text: Migration crashes with NoMethodError when the code is executed
Migration uses unparameterized SQL string interpolation for host values in the INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts statement, breaking the INSERT when a host value contains a quote
The uncategorized_category_id fallback lookup in the migration has the same unguarded [0]['value'] pattern that can raise on nil
save_host dereferences params[:embeddable_host][:host] unconditionally, so a request missing that envelope raises a 500 instead of a 400/422
Store.js plural hydration branch throws if the serialized *_ids value is null (obj[k].map on null)

hydrated || [] is dead code in store.js hydration; failed lookups produce [undefined, ...] garbage entries and foo_ids is unconditionally deleted, mutating/degrading the payload shape for all store consumers instead of keeping raw ids when no side-loaded records exist
Category model lacks has_many :embeddable_hosts with dependent handling, so deleting a category leaves embeddable host rows pointing at a nonexistent category id
Controller doesn't validate that the submitted category_id refers to an existing category
Migration SQL INSERT uses string interpolation for host values, so a single quote in legacy data breaks the migration

Migration crashes with NoMethodError when embed_category setting is absent or empty: `[0]['id']` on an empty result set returns nil and `nil['id']` raises, aborting the migration before the fallback is reached

Migration INSERT uses unescaped string interpolation for host values, causing SQL syntax errors on quotes; also nil category_id from a missing uncategorized category lookup makes the INSERT syntactically invalid

Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update and #destroy raise NoMethodError on nil when the record doesn't exist (stale tab, concurrent edits), producing a 500 instead of a 404; missing params[:embeddable_host] also raises
No category existence validation on EmbeddableHost allows stale category_id after category deletion, causing TopicEmbed.import to create topics with non-existent category and frontend null rendering
Frontend destroyRecord has no .catch failure handler, so failed destroy requests (e.g., server 500) silently leave the row with no user feedback
Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update with a nonexistent id: EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first returns nil and save_host calls host.host = ... on nil, raising NoMethodError and a 500

Data migration copies hosts verbatim from the old embeddable_hosts setting without stripping the scheme, so migrated rows like 'http://discourse.org' never match the lower(host) = uri.host lookup, silently breaking embeds post-migration
Migration raises NoMethodError on fresh install when no embed_category row exists in site_settings, breaking rake db:migrate from scratch
Migration uses raw string-interpolated INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...) which produces broken SQL if a host value contains a quote
JS store test asserts the wrong fruit's colors because the pretender handler for /fruits/:id returns fruits[0] unconditionally, so the test verifies the mock rather than actual behavior

_hydrateEmbedded plural branch calls obj[k].map(...) directly and throws 'Cannot read property map of null' if a serializer emits null ids; also unsanitized null/undefined entries from failed _lookupSubType; no tests exercise empty or missing ids

Destructive non-reversible migration written as change: irreversible DELETE of site_settings with no up/down reversal, plus raw string-interpolated INSERTs that break on values containing quotes and are an injection-shaped hazard

Dead code and null leaks in plural hydration branch in store.js.es6: '|| []' after map is dead code, and null entries from _lookupSubType are silently included in the array unlike the singular branch's guard

Global coupling and undefined-category risk in embeddable-host component save action: reaching into Discourse.Category registry diverges from server behavior (which coerces to uncategorized_category_id), causing table to render out of sync until reload
Migration also crashes if embed_category was set but the matching category was renamed or deleted, since the INNER JOIN drops out and [0] is nil

Backfill copies raw host values (e.g. 'http://discourse.org') into embeddable_hosts.host without applying the model's normalization (stripping scheme and path), so migrated entries never match in record_for_host comparisons and embedding silently breaks
Backfill inserts empty or whitespace-only lines from split("\n") as junk rows because model validation callbacks are bypassed
create_table uses force: true, which silently drops and recreates a pre-existing embeddable_hosts table, losing data in partially-migrated or re-run scenarios
Admin controller update and destroy actions raise NoMethodError (500) when the embeddable host record is not found, instead of returning 404/error JSON
No unique index on embeddable_hosts.host, allowing duplicate rows and making the category applied to embedded topics nondeterministic since record_for_host uses .first

Migration crashes on installs that never changed embed_category: site_settings rows are lazily created, so the query returns zero rows and [0]['id'] raises NoMethodError, aborting the migration; same failure mode applies to the uncategorized_category_id lookup on line 14

Migrated hosts keep scheme/path in the host value (raw SQL insert bypasses the model's before_validation normalizer), so hosts recorded like 'http://eviltrout.com' or with paths silently fail host_allowed? against record_for_host's exact lower(host) = uri.host comparison, breaking embeds post-upgrade
Admin::EmbeddableHostsController update/destroy raise NoMethodError (500) instead of 404 when the id is stale/unknown because the nil record isn't handled

Validation regex permits a port (:\d{1,5}) and before_validation strips only scheme/path, but record_for_host compares against uri.host which never includes a port, so hosts saved with a port like example.com:8080 can never match
Plural hydration in store.js throws TypeError if a payload contains null for an *_ids key (obj[k].map on null)

Plural hydration branch assigns hydrated || [] unconditionally and injects a new obj[plural] property (potentially with null entries for non-side-loaded ids), and the regex now matches any key ending in _ids across all API payloads, not just intended ones
Migration SQL interpolates unescaped host values, so legacy hosts containing a single quote break the migration mid-way, leaving a half-migrated state
Validation regex \.[a-z]{2,5} rejects TLDs longer than 5 characters (.museum, .technology) and hosts without a TLD (localhost), with no dev-mode bypass in TopicRetriever/TopicEmbed
No uniqueness validation or unique index on host allows duplicate hosts with different categories, making the matched category nondeterministic (record_for_host uses .first with no order)
Frontend destroyRecord() has no .catch, so delete failures are silent and the row stays in the table with no error shown
After save() succeeds, Discourse.Category.findById returns undefined when categoryId is null, so the UI displays a blank category (disagreeing with the persisted uncategorized default) until reload

mrv_findings.text: Migration query for 'embed_category' site setting crashes with NoMethodError on any site where the setting was never changed from its default, because site_settings only has a row when changed, making result[0] nil — blocking all deploys

Migration fallback query for 'uncategorized_category_id' crashes with NoMethodError when that row isn't materialized, and when it is materialized with the default empty string, .to_i yields 0, producing embeddable_hosts rows with category_id = 0 that point at no category

Migrated host values are inserted verbatim via raw SQL, so values with schemes and paths (e.g. 'http://discourse.org') skip the before_validation strip and never match record_for_host's host comparison, causing all existing embeds to fail with Discourse::InvalidAccess after deploy
SQL string interpolation of legacy host values breaks the migration outright if any value contains a quote
EmbeddableHostsController#update raises NoMethodError (unhandled 500 instead of 404) when the record id doesn't exist because save_host calls host.host= on nil
EmbeddableHostsController#destroy reports success for a nonexistent record because nil.destroy is a no-op that renders success
Fabricator contents are swapped between files: category_fabricator.rb defines the embeddable_host fabricator and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb contains the category fabricators
EmbeddingController#update accepts and discards all input, reading nothing from params and writing nothing, so any PUT to the endpoint silently no-ops

Store.js `hydrated || []` fallback is dead code since map never returns falsy, while the real failure mode (missing side-load records producing null entries in the array, causing rendering errors in embedding.hbs) is unguarded
Migration crashes with NoMethodError when embed_category setting is empty (default ''), because the SQL JOIN returns no rows and nil['id'] is called before the category_id == 0 fallback can trigger

Migration inserts embeddable_hosts values verbatim including http:// schemes and paths, but the new exact host comparison in EmbeddableHost.record_for_host will reject referers for existing hosts entered with schemes/paths, silently breaking the feature after upgrade
Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update and #destroy crash with 500 when the given ID doesn't exist because save_host(nil) and host.destroy are called on nil without a 404 check
Migration interpolates raw setting values into INSERT SQL without sanitization, allowing SQL injection or migration failure on values containing single quotes
The only tests for the new admin endpoints assert class inheritance, with no coverage of CRUD paths, category fallback, validation errors, or the EmbeddingSerializer/store hydration contract
The contents of category_fabricator.rb and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb were accidentally swapped, putting each fabricator in the wrong file
Admin::EmbeddingController#update persists nothing despite the route and frontend saveChanges action existing, so saving silently does nothing and returns unchanged data
No uniqueness constraint on the embeddable_hosts host column, allowing duplicate rows for the same host with different categories and nondeterministic category assignment in record_for_host

Fabricator file contents are swapped: category_fabricator.rb contains the :embeddable_host fabricator while embeddable_host_fabricator.rb contains the old category fabricator definitions, likely an accidental file-swap/git mv mistake masked by global Fabricator registration

The update action in admin/embedding_controller.rb is a no-op dead implementation: fetch_embedding rebuilds the record from EmbeddableHost.all and nothing is ever written, yet routes, controller, serializer usage, and frontend JS save actions all exist to serve it

Migration's embed_category data conversion joins site_settings.value to categories.name, but the setting was consumed as a category id passed to PostCreator, so the join may silently fail leaving category_id == 0 and migrating all hosts to uncategorized

Migration irreversibly and unconditionally deletes legacy site settings ('embeddable_hosts', 'embed_category') with no down path, even when the preceding conversion was skipped or produced a fallback category, making the original values unrecoverable

The removed SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? guard in topic.rb expandable_first_post? was replaced by nothing instead of an EmbeddableHost.exists? check, dropping the invariant that first-post truncation only applies while embedding is configured, and the related spec passes vacuously hiding the regression
Unrelated drive-by lint edits (unused variable removals) in topic_spec.rb digest specs have no connection to the embedding feature, polluting the diff and review surface
Locale key admin.embedding.edit is defined but never referenced by any template or component; the template uses icon-only buttons with no label, making it a dead locale entry
Admin embedding update action is a silent no-op: it re-renders the serializer without reading or persisting params, returning HTTP 200 while discarding the caller's payload

Host case normalization asymmetry: validation accepts uppercase hosts (regex with /i, no downcasing in before_validation) but record_for_host matches lower(host) = uri.host where URI host is always lowercase, so stored hosts like 'Eviltrout.com' can never match embed requests
No UNIQUE index on host (or lower(host)) in the embeddable_hosts migration, allowing the same host to be registered twice with .first arbitrarily picking one
Port is accepted by host validation regex but record_for_host compares against URI#host which excludes the port, making stored hosts with ports permanently unmatchable
Embeddable hosts controller update/destroy lack not-found guards, causing NoMethodError on nil (500) instead of 404 for stale or hand-crafted ids
category_id is assigned from params with no existence validation, no FK, and no presence check on the belongs_to :category association, allowing dead category references
Category deletion leaves embeddable_hosts rows dangling with no dependent/nullify hook, breaking TopicEmbed.import and causing embeds to fail or land in Uncategorized
category_fabricator.rb and embeddable_host_fabricator.rb have their contents swapped: the category file defines Fabricator(:embeddable_host) and the host file contains all the category fabricators
Migration crashes with NoMethodError on nil when 'embed_category' site setting was never set or doesn't match a category name, aborting db:migrate for default installs and blocking deploys

Migrated embeddable hosts are inserted raw via SQL, bypassing the model's before_validation normalization that strips http(s):// prefixes and paths, causing previously allowed hosts to fail matching and get Discourse::InvalidAccess on /embed/comments
Migration permanently DELETEs the embeddable_hosts and embed_category site settings with no rollback path, causing unrecoverable data loss if any INSERT fails midway or rollback is needed

Fabricator file contents are swapped: category_fabricator.rb contains only the EmbeddableHost fabricator while embeddable_host_fabricator.rb contains the Category fabricators, misleading future contributors editing the wrong file
embedding_controller.rb update action renders a serialization of the never-mutated @embedding, silently discarding all submitted changes from the PUT while responding 200 with success JSON
embeddable_hosts_controller.rb update and destroy fetch EmbeddableHost by id with no nil check, causing NoMethodError and HTTP 500 instead of a 404 or validation error for stale or fabricated ids
topic.rb expandable_first_post? dropped the SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? guard, changing semantics so deleting all embeddable hosts no longer disables truncation for existing embedded topics
SQL string interpolation of unvalidated site setting values into raw INSERT in migration, allowing SQL injection or migration crash on single quotes
Unguarded nil on user-supplied params[:id] lookup in update and destroy actions of EmbeddableHostsController, causing unhandled 500 errors for stale or invalid ids

The entire spec for Admin::EmbeddableHostsController is only an ancestry assertion (Admin::EmbeddableHostsController < Admin::AdminController), verifying none of the new behavior: the blank-category_id fallback to SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id, the render_json_error path for invalid hosts, destroy of a nonexistent id (which would 500 on nil), or the serialization shape

Admin::EmbeddingController#update contains no persistence logic at all — it just re-renders the serialized @embedding — while the frontend saveChanges action calls update({}) expecting to save; no test issues a PUT and checks that anything changes, so the save embedding feature is a no-op that the passing suite gives false confidence about

The 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' test in topic_spec.rb now verifies a branch that no longer exists after removal of the SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? guard from Topic#expandable_first_post?; it passes only because embed_truncate defaults to false, and the new semantic (topic with has_topic_embed? and embed_truncate true is expandable even with zero hosts configured) has no coverage

The 'raises an error with a missing host' test in embed_controller_spec.rb is stale: it claims to cover host-config denial but passes only because no referer is stubbed, so the referer check fires instead; the new empty-hosts behavior (no rows in embeddable_hosts) is never directly asserted

The new plural _ids hydration branch in store.js.es6 is only tested on the happy path where all ids exist in the side-loaded payload; there is no test for an id absent from the root payload, where _lookupSubType returns null and the hydrated array silently contains null entries while the original _ids key is unconditionally deleted, crashing consumers like {{#each fruit.colors}} with unrecoverable data

The 'find embedded' test in store-test.js.es6 claims to load fruit 2 (banana, color_ids: [3]) but the pretender handler ignores the request id and always returns fruits[0] (apple, color_ids: [1,2]), so the assertions verify apple's data; the test passes only by mock accident and cannot catch hydration bugs specific to single-element color_ids arrays

The topic_embed.rb change replacing SiteSetting.embed_category with eh.try(:category_id) has only one spec assertion covering the matching-host case; no test exercises the branch where the imported URL's host is not registered (record_for_host returns nil), causing the topic to be created uncategorized instead of in the previously configured embed_category

Migration crashes with NoMethodError when the 'embed_category' setting row doesn't exist in site_settings or its value doesn't match a category name, because execute(...)[0] is nil on the default configuration
The 'uncategorized_category_id' fallback queries site_settings for a value that is a computed Ruby method on SiteSetting, not a database row, so the fallback path also crashes with NoMethodError

The migration irreversibly DELETEs the embeddable_hosts and embed_category site_settings rows inside def change with no down method, backup, or restore path, permanently losing configuration on rollback

Migrated host values are inserted verbatim without normalizing schemes/paths, so hosts stored as 'http://discourse.org' never match the new EmbeddableHost.record_for_host query comparing against uri.host, silently breaking previously-allowed embeds
Host values are interpolated into raw SQL INSERT statements without quoting or parameterization, allowing syntax errors or SQL injection from single quotes/backslashes in stored values

The deploy removes the settings from site_settings.yml and deletes SiteSetting.allows_embeddable_host? in the same step as the data migration, so old application servers during a rolling restart raise undefined-method/missing-setting errors with no expand/contract transitional phase
